M1.rule: smallest batch first; a failed or aborted configuration skips its larger batches; the CPU first, MPS only after M3 passed; MPS activation checkpointing as rules.mps_checkpointing

M2.gradient_check_when: once, before the first configuration that relies on activation checkpointing
M2.when: on the chosen CPU configuration, before any MPS unit, when its batch 32 has a peak above peak_limit_bytes, swap growth above swap_growth_tolerance_bytes, or a memory abort; on MPS when its batch 32 completed without activation checkpointing and does not fit

M3.activation_checkpointing: as rules.mps_checkpointing; the checks that train wrap their models, on MPS and on the CPU

prior.rule: priced by its content: check (b)'s forward and backward and check (c)'s steps on the CPU at 2 threads, at the first run's step time there with activation checkpointing, and those plus checks (a) and (d) on MPS; CPU-seconds at wall x 2 threads, the child's whole wall as GPU time; retries priced as one M3

M4.activation_checkpointing: as the MPS batch 32 of M1 and M2; a retried M4 runs M7 again

order: setup: the synthetic export and the shipped models
M1 on the CPU (cpu x2, cpu x8; batch 8, 16, 32)
M2 on the CPU (only if the chosen CPU configuration's batch 32 does not fit)
M3 (MPS only; with activation checkpointing if the CPU's batch 32 needs it)
M1 on MPS (mps x2 once M3 passed; batch 8, 16, 32; batch 32 with activation checkpointing if the CPU's needs it)
M2 on MPS (only if its batch 32 completed without activation checkpointing and does not fit)
M4 with M7 during it (MPS only)
a memory abort of an MPS unit without activation checkpointing: one retry with it

recipe.wrappers: every R1 wrapper on, early stopping off

rules.budget: the run's limits are not part of this plan: the record states them (spend, approval), the step's own below gate 3 or the CPU-hours the owner approved; refused before the start above the limits; a measurement or retry whose prior would pass a limit is not started (M4 and its retry: unless their whole lifetime, seconds plus overhead_seconds, fits the remaining GPU-minutes); the run stops once the measured spend passes one
rules.child_deadline: CPU child: remaining CPU-seconds / threads; MPS child: the smaller of remaining GPU-minutes x 60 and remaining CPU-seconds / 2; M4: remaining GPU-minutes x 60, its CPU time watched; parent timeout: deadline + 60 s
rules.device_comparison: the sustained MPS step time (M4, with activation checkpointing when it ran with it) against the fastest CPU configuration that runs batch 32: as is where it fits, with activation checkpointing where M2 passed (the times as is when none does)
rules.mps_checkpointing: M3, the MPS batch 32 of M1 and M4 run with activation checkpointing from their first attempt when the chosen CPU configuration's batch 32 does not fit as is and M2 passed there; an MPS unit that ends memory_abort without it is retried once with it, once M2's gradient bit-identity passed (run first when needed) and the retry's prior fits the budget; the MPS units after it, from that batch up, run with it; both attempts are recorded; a retry is charged to retries
